description: 繁體中文：Nivqo Manager 顯示版本維持 1.34.0，本次同版 replacement 修正 Nivqo 正式 core revision（例如 0.7.2-nivqo.1）被誤判為 prerelease，導致 Facebook / Messenger 已有新版核心時首頁不顯示「更新／重新修補」的問題。現在 -nivqo.N 會正確視為 stable revision；dev / beta / rc 等仍維持 prerelease。HushFacebook 維持 0.7.2-nivqo.1 / 70 patches，HushMessenger 維持 0.21.0-nivqo.1 / 33 patches。 English: Nivqo Manager remains versionName 1.34.0 as an in-place replacement. This build fixes Nivqo stable core revisions such as 0.7.2-nivqo.1 being misclassified as prereleases, which could suppress the Facebook/Messenger home re-patch update badge even when a newer core had already been downloaded. -nivqo.N is now treated as stable, while dev/beta/rc remain prerelease.
